reference.notes:
I'm leaving the code as it is, because the spec doesn't support this test.

- **What the test checks:** that the result contains `--digest <digest>` and `--repo lunox-work/sandbox-factory`.
- **What the spec says:** `spec.md` states that it "replaces those assertions". The command must be exactly `gh api repos/lunox-work/sandbox-factory/attestations/<digest>`.
- **Why both can't pass:** the rule "The command never names the gh attestation verify --digest invocation that does not exist" says the result must not contain `--digest` or `--repo`. The new tests in `test/provenance-doc.test.ts` check exactly that. Making this old test pass would break them and print the command the spec is removing.

The rest of the suite passed in my last run: 103 of 104 tests.

test/build-info.test.ts :: verifyCommand takes the digest, which needs no registry access :: the spec replaces its assertions; it expects `--digest <digest>` and `--repo …`, but the spec requires exactly `gh api repos/lunox-work/sandbox-factory/attestations/<digest>` with neither fragment present, which `provenance-doc.test.ts` also checks
